response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 13+ years of delivery across web, backend, mobile and some embedded work, but the profile is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirement: deep, current C++ expertise. C++ appears only in a six-month stint at National Instruments (2014) and an academic thesis project; the last decade is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang full-stack and platform work. There is no evidence of industrial automation domain experience, IEC 62443 / Secure Development Lifecycle practice, MQTT or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), or Azure. Some adjacent strengths exist — low-latency concurrent systems at Sociomantic, event-driven platform architecture at GISCollective, strong testing/mentoring culture — but the gap on the primary technical and security competencies is too large for a mid-senior specialist hire.
strengths: 13+ years senior-level delivery, incl. low-latency high-throughput distributed systems
Strong testing, TDD, CI/CD and mentoring/teaching track record
Event-driven platform architecture and DevOps/Kubernetes experience
concerns: C++/STL experience is minimal and roughly a decade stale
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL or secure-engineering background
No MQTT, OPC UA/Modbus, or Azure exposure evident
